look_here_first: Look for an unwinged perennial stem with mostly opposite coarse leaves and a few very large yellow daisy-like heads. The opposite leaves and lack of stem wings separate it from many other Verbesina.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Asteraceae composite heads with yellow ray florets surrounding many yellow disc florets.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: large solitary or few yellow heads

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: large ray florets around raised yellow disc

lookalikes.differences: Compared with Verbesina virginica, V. lindheimeri is shorter with large yellow heads and mostly opposite leaves; frostweed is taller, white-flowered, and often has winged stems.
